tasks.title: Wire BRAND.socket into the narration socket path
tasks.description: src/brand.ts defines BRAND.socket = '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock' (tested in test/brand.test.ts) but it is dead — never imported or read anywhere. The actual narration socket path is still the literal '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock', hardcoded independently in src/narration.ts (DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH), src/commands/run.ts (narrationSocketPath), src/commands/narrate.ts (DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH), lib/ralph_narrate_server.py (DEFAULT_SOCKET), and .claude/hooks/{narrate,speak,notify}.sh (SOCKET=). Unlike dataDir/configFile/tempPrefix, this identifier was never given the dual-name (current-preferred, legacy-fallback) treatment established in CLAUDE.md's 'Branding and the legacy layout' section, so it doesn't participate in the .cairn/.ralph rename at all. Decide whether to (a) apply the same current-preferred/legacy-fallback pattern to the socket path (probe both '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock' and '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock' at connect/health-check time, like findDataDir does for directories), or (b) remove the unused BRAND.socket constant and its test if socket-path branding is intentionally out of scope. Note the hook shell scripts (.claude/hooks/*.sh) are per-project generated files (written by `ralph init`), so any fix needs to flow through whatever generates them, not just the TS/Python readers.
tasks.notes:
# Task #48 — iteration 1 (re-dispatch): verification only, no new code

## Summary

**The implementation was already complete and committed** as `8b591af [src] Task #48:
Wire BRAND.socket into the narration socket path` (14 files, +402/−79). This iteration
found no code work outstanding. The task was re-dispatched because post-iteration test
validation **falsely** reverted it to `in-progress` — a bug in the validator, not in the
task. Root cause diagnosed and filed as **task #50** (see below).

Everything under "Changes"/"Tests"/"Docs" in the previous notes (retained in the task's
`notes` field) is accurate as landed. Re-verified this iteration:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `bun test` (repo root) | **862 pass, 0 fail**, 1796 expects, 31 files |
| `bun build --target=bun src/index.ts --outfile /tmp/cairn-healthcheck` | clean, 0.44 MB, exit 0 |
| `/tmp/ralph-tts.{sock,pid}` literals outside `src/brand.ts` | **none** (only `LEGACY.socket`/`LEGACY.pidFile` at `src/brand.ts:42-43`) |
| `TODO(#48)` in shipped source | **none** (only `test/legacy-markers.test.ts:110-113`, the guard that forbids it) |
| Every call site routed through the resolvers | confirmed — see below |

Call-site wiring, spot-checked line by line:

- `src/narration.ts:61` `findNarrationSocketPath()`, `:91` `findNarrationPidFile()`,
  `:25` `HOOK_SOCKET_RE`. No `DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH` constant remains.
- `src/commands/run.ts:300` deps type, `:346` real resolver as the default, `:413`
  `deps.findNarrationSocketPath(projectRoot)`.
- `src/commands/narrate.ts:39` `?? findNarrationPidFile()`, `:42`
  `?? findNarrationSocketPath(findProjectRoot())`.
- `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py:24` `DEFAULT_SOCKET = "/tmp/cairn-tts.sock"`, `:216` the
  `CAIRN_NARRATE_SOCKET` → `RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET` env chain. Unchanged, as intended.

## Why this task was re-dispatched — the real bug (now task #50)

`src/test-validator.ts:94` runs a task's `tests` with
`cwd = path.resolve(projectRoot, task.directory)`. Task #48's directory is `src`, and its
test command is the repo-root-scoped `bun test`. Run from `src/`, bun finds no test files
(they all live in `test/`) and **exits 1**:

```
$ cd <repo>/src && bun test ; echo $?
error: 0 test files matching **{.test,.spec,_test_,_spec_}.{js,ts,jsx,tsx} in --cwd=".../ralph/src"
1
```

`CANT_RUN_PATTERNS` (`src/test-validator.ts:19`) is
`['missing script','not found','no such file','enoent','cannot find module','module not
found']`. **None matches "0 test files matching"**, so `isCantRunError()` returns false,
control falls past the infrastructure branch at `:108` to the revert branch at `:115`, and
a finished task is marked `in-progress` with the note *"Post-iteration test validation
failed — reverted to in-progress."*

The suite it was actually judging passes 862/862.

This is an **infinite loop for any task whose `directory` is a subdirectory of the repo
root** while its test command is root-scoped: complete → falsely reverted → re-dispatched
→ complete → … Filed as **task #50** (priority 1, so it is picked up next) with the fix
(extend `CANT_RUN_PATTERNS` to cover bun/jest/vitest no-tests-found messages, routing to
the existing `:108` branch) and a TDD test case.

The same `taskDir` cwd in `src/health-check.ts:55` is why every iteration of this project
opens with `BUILD HEALTH CHECK FAILED … FileNotFound opening root directory "src"` — the
health check `bun build --target=bun src/index.ts …` is repo-root-relative but runs from
`src/`, so it resolves `src/src/index.ts`. **Same root cause, different file, different
call** (a health check may legitimately be root-scoped, so it is not obviously the same
fix). Noted inside #50 as explicitly out of its scope rather than filed separately.

## If #50 is not fixed before this task is validated again

This task will be reverted a second time by the same mechanism. That is a false negative,
not a regression — verify with `bun test` **from the repo root** before believing any
future revert of #48.

## Still open for whoever closes the round (unchanged from prior notes)

Per CLAUDE.md's pin/unpin procedure: re-run `./install.sh` and restore `healthCheck` in
`ralph.json` to its real outfile (`dist/cairn`); both are user-managed for this round.
Then migrate this repo itself with `cairn migrate`, which moves `.ralph/` → `.cairn/`,
`ralph.json` → `cairn.json`, and repoints `.claude/hooks/*.sh` at `/tmp/cairn-tts.sock`.
Until then this repo's hooks correctly keep resolving to `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock` via
`findNarrationSocketPath` — that is the fallback working, not a mismatch.

tasks.title: test-validator: treat 'no test files found' as an infrastructure error, not a test failure
tasks.description:
src/test-validator.ts runs a task's tests with cwd = <projectRoot>/<task.directory> (line 94). When a task's directory is a subdirectory (e.g. 'src') but its test command is repo-root-scoped ('bun test'), bun exits 1 with stderr: `error: 0 test files matching **{.test,.spec,_test_,_spec_}.{js,ts,jsx,tsx} in --cwd="/path/to/repo/src"`. None of CANT_RUN_PATTERNS (line 19) matches that string, so isCantRunError() returns false and the task is REVERTED to in-progress as if its tests had genuinely failed.

This burned a full iteration on task #48: the complete suite passes 862/862 at the repo root, but post-iteration validation reverted the finished task and the run loop re-dispatched it. Left unfixed this is an infinite loop for any task whose directory is a subdir of the repo root.

Fix: add a pattern matching bun's no-test-files message (e.g. 'test files matching') to CANT_RUN_PATTERNS, and the equivalents for other runners (jest: 'no tests found', vitest: 'no test files found'). Finding zero tests means the command could not run meaningfully in that cwd, so it must take the existing isCantRunError branch at line 108 (append a note, do NOT revert).

TDD: add a case to test/test-validator.test.ts asserting a 'no test files found' stderr with exit 1 yields status 'error' and leaves the task 'complete'.

Related but SEPARATE (do not bundle): src/health-check.ts:55 uses the same taskDir cwd, which is why this project's health check reports 'FileNotFound opening root directory src' at the start of every iteration. Same root cause, different file, different decision (a health check may legitimately be repo-root-scoped).
